in_english.name: Zaleha

The name is mentioned in the Quran as the wife of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph). In Islamic tradition, Zaleha symbolizes beauty, kindness, and good morals. The name is popular across Muslim cultures for its positive connotations and historical significance.
